blocks.html: Where terms are not defined in this code and are defined in the New York City Fuel Gas Code, New York City Fire Code, New York City Mechanical Code, New York City Electrical Code, New York City Plumbing Code, or the New York City Energy Conservation Code, such terms shall have the meanings ascribed to them as in those codes.
